explanation: fields_view_get(), _fields_view_get() and load_views() emit a DeprecationWarning in 16.0, where nothing in Odoo calls them any more (so overrides no longer take effect), and are removed in 17.0, so override get_view() or _get_view() instead.

The model methods flush(), recompute() and invalidate_cache() emit a DeprecationWarning in 16.0 and are removed in 17.0, so use flush_model(), flush_recordset() or self.env.flush_all() and invalidate_model(), invalidate_recordset() or self.env.invalidate_all() instead.

explanation: Cursor.autocommit() emits a DeprecationWarning in 16.0 and is removed in 17.0, so set autocommit on the underlying connection (cr._cnx.autocommit = True, as the 16.0 warning says) or drop the call.

Odoo 16.0 splits odoo.addons.web.controllers.main into separate modules and leaves only lazy proxies that emit a DeprecationWarning, and 18.0 empties it, so import Home, Binary, DataSet, ReportController and the other names from odoo.addons.web.controllers.home, .binary, .dataset, .report and their sibling modules instead.

explanation: Odoo 16.0 renames the stock.production.lot model (table stock_production_lot) to stock.lot, so model references, inherits, xmlids such as stock.model_stock_production_lot and raw SQL on the old table must use the new name.
Odoo 16.0 renames the stock.location.route model to stock.route, so model references, inherits, xmlids such as stock.model_stock_location_route and raw SQL on the old table must use the new name.
Odoo 16.0 renames the stock.picking field move_lines to move_ids, so code, views and reports that use picking.move_lines must use move_ids.

Odoo 16.0 renames the payment.acquirer model to payment.provider and the acquirer_id, acquirer_ref and acquirer_reference fields of payment tokens and transactions to provider_id, provider_ref and provider_reference.

Odoo 16.0 removes the ir.translation model and stores each translated field's translations as JSONB in the field's own column, so read and write them with get_field_translations(), update_field_translations() or with_context(lang=...) instead.

explanation: Odoo 16.0 removes the account.account.type model, the user_type_id field of accounts and the account.data_account_type_* records, so use the account_type selection field of account.account instead.

Odoo 16.0 removes the account.analytic.tag model, the analytic_tag_ids fields and the account_analytic_id field of purchase and purchase requisition lines, so analytic data is carried by the analytic_distribution JSON field of analytic.mixin instead.

Odoo 16.0 renames the mail.channel.partner model to mail.channel.member and the channel field channel_last_seen_partner_ids to channel_member_ids, and 17.0 renames the member model again to discuss.channel.member.

Odoo 16.0 rewrites odoo.http, removing the WebRequest, JsonRequest and HttpRequest classes and request.jsonrequest, so read the JSON-RPC body with request.get_json_data() or the route's keyword arguments instead.

ir.actions.report._render_qweb_pdf(), _render_qweb_html() and _render_qweb_text() take the report reference (xmlid, report_name, id or record) as their first argument from 16.0, so calls that pass record ids first and overrides with the old (res_ids, data) signature must be updated.

Odoo 16.0 rewrites how account.move keeps its lines in sync, removing _recompute_dynamic_lines(), _move_autocomplete_invoice_lines_values(), _onchange_invoice_line_ids(), the _get_fields_onchange_* and _get_price_total_and_subtotal helpers and the exclude_from_invoice_tab field, so write invoice lines as plain line values and tell them apart by display_type instead.

Odoo 16.0 replaces the coupon and gift_card apps (coupon.program, coupon.coupon, coupon.rule, coupon.reward and gift.card) with the loyalty app, so use the loyalty.program, loyalty.card, loyalty.rule and loyalty.reward models instead.

explanation: The product.pricelist methods get_product_price(), get_products_price(), get_product_price_rule(), price_get(), price_rule_get() and price_rule_get_multi() are removed in 16.0, so call _get_product_price(product, quantity, uom, date), _get_products_price(), _get_product_price_rule() or _price_get() instead, whose third positional argument is no longer the partner.

Odoo 16.0 removes the account.tax.report and account.tax.report.line models, so tax reports must be defined as account.report records with account.report.line and account.report.expression (engine tax_tags) instead.

Odoo 17.0 rejects views that use the attrs or states attributes (the view fails validation), so write the conditions as Python expressions directly in the invisible, readonly and required attributes instead.

The field parameter states (per-state readonly and required) is no longer supported in 17.0 and only logs a warning, so express the condition with readonly or required attributes in the views instead.
Odoo 17.0 renames the models mail.channel, mail.channel.member and mail.channel.rtc.session to discuss.channel, discuss.channel.member and discuss.channel.rtc.session.
message_post_with_view() and message_post_with_template() are removed in 17.0, so call message_post_with_source() with the view or mail template (record or xmlid) and render_values instead.

The private _read_group() that 16.0 added with read_group()'s arguments (domain, fields, groupby, offset, limit, orderby, lazy) takes (domain, groupby, aggregates, having, offset, limit, order) in 17.0 and returns a list of tuples, and _read_group_raw(), _read_group_prepare() and _read_group_process_groupby() are removed, so calls and overrides written for 15.0 or 16.0 must be rewritten.

From 17.0 the onchange machinery ignores the domain key returned by an @api.onchange method (15.0 and 16.0 still applied it and logged a deprecation warning), so declare the domain on the field or in the view instead.

explanation: BaseModel.search() and _search() no longer accept the count parameter in 17.0, so call search_count(domain) instead.

api.Environment.manage() and Environment.clear_upon_failure(), deprecated with a DeprecationWarning since 15.0, are removed in 17.0, so drop the with api.Environment.manage(): wrapper and use cr.savepoint() instead of clear_upon_failure().

The <report> and <act_window> shortcut tags, deprecated with a warning in 15.0 and 16.0, are no longer accepted in 17.0 data files (the file fails schema validation), so declare ir.actions.report and ir.actions.act_window records with <record> instead.

explanation: Odoo 17.0 replaces the account.invoice.send wizard with account.move.send, so inherited wizards, views and code that create it must target account.move.send instead.

Odoo 17.0 removes the chart template models account.account.template, account.tax.template, account.group.template, account.fiscal.position.template, account.reconcile.model.template and their line templates, so chart templates are provided by @template-decorated methods on the abstract account.chart.template model instead.
Odoo 17.0 removes the stock.immediate.transfer and mrp.immediate.production wizards and the immediate_transfer field of pickings, so code and views that create, inherit or read them must be removed.
Odoo 17.0 removes the qty_done field of stock.move.line and the quantity_done field of stock.move, so read and write their quantity field (and mark processed moves with picked) instead.
product.product.price_compute() and product.template.price_compute() are renamed _price_compute() in 17.0, so calls and overrides must use the new name.

Odoo 17.0 removes the hr.employee fields address_home_id (the private address partner) and is_address_home_a_company, so use the employee's own private_street, private_city, private_zip, private_state_id, private_country_id, private_email and private_phone fields instead.

odoo.modules.get_module_resource() is an alias of get_resource_path() that emits the same DeprecationWarning from 17.0 and is removed in 19.0, so use odoo.tools.misc.file_path('module/path/to/file') instead.

Odoo 18.0 deprecates the kanban-box and kanban-menu templates (the web client logs a warning) and 19.0 no longer accepts them, so define 'card' and 'menu' templates instead.

odoo.tools.ustr() emits a DeprecationWarning in 18.0 and 19.0 and is removed in 20.0, so use str() or bytes.decode() instead.
Odoo 19.0 ignores the _sql_constraints attribute and only logs a warning, so declare each constraint as a models.Constraint class attribute instead.
@route(type='json') still works in 19.0 as a deprecated alias that emits a DeprecationWarning, so use type='jsonrpc' instead.
The model properties _cr, _uid and _context still work in 19.0 but emit a DeprecationWarning, so use self.env.cr, self.env.uid and self.env.context instead.

Odoo 19.0 removes the res.partner.title model and the title field on res.partner, so references to them must be removed or moved to a custom field.
The @api.returns decorator is removed in 19.0, so drop it and return the recordset directly.

Model.read_group(domain, fields, groupby, ..., lazy) emits a DeprecationWarning in 19.0 and in 20.0 is replaced by read_group(domain, groupby, aggregates, ...) returning tuples, so use _read_group() in server code or formatted_read_group() for formatted results.

Registry.clear_cache() and clear_all_caches() are removed in 20.0, so call self.env.transaction.invalidate_ormcache(cache_name) instead.
type="base64" on file-loading <field> elements still works in 20.0 but emits a DeprecationWarning, so use type="bytes" instead.

explanation: Odoo 20.0 splits odoo.http into submodules and the package itself only exposes request, route, Controller and Response, so import content_disposition and Stream from odoo.http.stream, serialize_exception from odoo.http.dispatcher, and the session and routing helpers from odoo.http.session and odoo.http.router.
Odoo 20.0 removes the odoo.osv package (including odoo.osv.expression and its constants), so build and combine domains with odoo.fields.Domain instead.
The ir.attachment field datas is removed in 20.0 (a datas value passed to create or write is dropped with a warning), so read and write the raw field (bytes) instead.

Odoo 20.0 removes the res.partner field company_type and computes is_company itself (stored and read-only), so views, domains and code that use company_type must be rewritten (reads can use is_company).

Odoo 20.0 removes company_registry from res.partner and res.company (partner identifiers are now held in vat and the additional_identifiers JSON field), so references to company_registry must be rewritten.
The ir.actions.report field report_file is removed in 20.0, so report records and values that set it fail to load and the field must be dropped (report_name remains).

Odoo 20.0 no longer re-exports Query, the SQL index helpers (create_index, index_exists, make_index_name, escape_psql, reverse_order, make_identifier), street_split, mod10r or the convert_*_import helpers from odoo.tools, so import Query from odoo.models and the others from odoo.tools.sql, odoo.tools.business_data and odoo.tools.convert.
